subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Does the security workflow owner approve moving the secret-bearing, release, scanning, and Codex-agent workflows to these 13 pinned upstream action revisions after the rebased exact-head checks pass?
rationale: The patch is mechanically correct, but repository ownership policy reserves approval of executable dependency changes in security-critical and credential-bearing workflows for a human security owner.

options.title: Approve After Exact-Head Gates
options.body: Rebase the Dependabot branch, require all affected workflow and security checks to pass, then approve and merge the reviewed SHA.

options.title: Split Affected Action
options.body: If a specific action fails or needs deeper review, remove it from this group and land the remaining verified revisions separately.

options.title: Hold Existing Pins
options.body: Leave the current revisions in place until the security owner is comfortable with the upstream release or additional live workflow evidence is available.

recommendation.title: Approve After Exact-Head Gates
recommendation.body: Rebase the Dependabot branch, require all affected workflow and security checks to pass, then approve and merge the reviewed SHA.
